svg.text: Cross-language EKF runtime throughput (unchecked; slowest to fastest)
Apple M1 | CPU/language: 10,000x20; Mech backend: 100,000x5; matched runtime/native controls: 500,000x40 | steady-state, sorted
Mech Cranelift SIMD-JIT parallel unchecked fast

Rows are ordered by throughput from slowest to fastest. Hatched bars are GPU lanes; solid bars are CPU lanes. Checked rows include candidate validation/publication; unchecked rows explicitly omit those guarantees. Native Metal rows are direct command submission; WGPU rows are retained as a portable transport control. Compilation, allocation, warmup, and final readback are excluded from the timed region.
